note: Compact tending STATUS strip (11-18). Replaces the needs card (ui/tag/needs-card*.png) during care. Care is automatic, so nothing on it is tappable. All PNGs are 2x: draw at half the pixel size. CSS: export/tend-strip.css, markup: export/tend-strip.html.

strip.placement: position:fixed; left:50%; bottom:16px; translateX(-50%) -> stage rect x500 y652 w280 h112 in the 1280x772 window. The camera .pip stays at x1062 y66 200x150, with no overlap.

nineSlice.note: edge tiles are 4 stitch periods so the dashed stitching stays even when it tiles

baked.note: same look at the fixed 280x112 size, as a single image

sun.art: ui/care/sun-glow-0..3.png by daylight fill, ui/care/sun-resting.png at night
sun.caption: daylight / resting

slots.iconsAtNight: use the DAY icons and dots on the night strip (the night icons go muddy on the grey paper), same rule as the night needs card
slots.done: ui/care/need-done.png at 16px on the icon's top-right shoulder

activeGlow.note: behind the icon while the camera sees that action. Fade in 350ms, gentle 2.4s breathe, and hold ~400ms after the signal drops

harvest.title: Ready to harvest
harvest.gardenBadge: ui/care/harvest-badge(-night).png in Sprout's floating badge slot
